description: Today's published CapCenter mortgage rate tables for a county (the same tables its rates page shows): Conventional, Veteran (VA) and FHA 30- and 15-year fixed, each row with rate, APR, points and ZERO Closing Costs, plus the scenario they were priced for, the as-of time, the source page and the required disclosures. Answers in Spanish with language=es (tasas hipotecarias de hoy).

county.description: Location slug as used on the CapCenter mortgage rates pages, e.g. henrico-county.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

purpose.description: purchase (default) or refinance: which rates page view.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

name: get_todays_rates
title: Get today's CapCenter mortgage rates
